fields.Name: Inbound: Website/Phone
fields.Description: Came to us through the website, email or a phone call.

_comments: THE NAMES ARE THE ONES THE SALES TEAM USES IN HUBSPOT. The six original types were renamed in
place (same IDs) so records already pointing at them follow; the five without an original are new.

fields.Name: Inbound: Social Media
fields.Description: Came to us through social media.

_comments: Former description, kept as the design note: Sourced through a channel or referral partner. A long window because partner pipelines mature slowly.

fields.Name: Inbound: Partner
fields.Description: Came to us through a channel or affiliate partner.

fields.Name: Inbound: Webinar
fields.Description: Came to us from a webinar we ran.

_comments: Former description, kept as the design note: We reached out first. IsInbound = 0 on both Outbound types is what a sourced-vs-generated pipeline split keys on.

fields.Name: Outbound: Campaign
fields.Description: We reached out first, as part of a campaign or sequence.

fields.Name: Outbound: Individual Prospecting
fields.Description: We reached out first, one to one.

fields.Name: Referral: Internal
fields.Description: Introduced by someone inside Blue Cypress.

_comments: Former description, kept as the design note: Introduced by a person who already knows us. A long attribution window, because a referral conversation often predates any recorded activity.
Former description, kept as the design note: The account was already ours; this is expansion, cross-sell or renewal demand. A full-year window, since the relationship IS the attribution.

fields.Name: Upsell: Existing Client
fields.Description: Demand from an existing client: expansion, cross-sell or renewal.

_comments: Former description, kept as the design note: Conference, webinar or sponsored session. IsPaid is 1 — events carry direct cost, so CAC reporting needs to separate them from organic inbound.

fields.Name: Event Marketing
fields.Description: Came to us from a conference or sponsored event.
